message.subject: Ultra-premium positioning for architectural
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the DPD fleet project—that scale of execution is impressive.

I'm reaching out because we're seeing more architectural and transit RFPs requiring 15-20 year warranties, and I thought you might be running into similar spec challenges. We work with companies looking to differentiate in that ultra-premium segment, particularly around graffiti resistance for high-visibility municipal installations.

Would you be open to a brief call to discuss how some teams are approaching this? I have a few case studies that might be relevant to your positioning strategy.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: The 30,000-vehicle DPD fleet project and the performance gap between current products and emerging 15-20 year specification requirements
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Graffiti resistance and extended warranty capabilities for premium architectural and transit segments
